business_summary: HYOJITO Co., Ltd. provides advertising and promotional services in Japan. It operates through three segments: Navita Business, Ad Promotion Business, and Signage Business. The company handles various forms of advertising, including map advertising; transportation advertising, such as station, vehicle, and bus advertising, as well as newspapers, magazines, tv, and radio; geo and other media advertising; and online advertising. It is also involved in planning, development, and installation of environmental, transportation, public facility, and commercial facility directional signage; and planning, production, and handling of station area guide maps, exclusive information for local governments, information for police boxes and driver's license exam centres, outdoor advertisements, and newspaper and magazine advertisements. In addition, the company develops and operates online media, including a tax-free shop search site, as well as provides digital signage solutions, web services, and medical supplies joint purchasing service. HYOJITO Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
